annotations.title: Get lead consent and follow-up settings

description:
[read-only] The brand's saved lead consent (text, version, title, checkboxLabel), whether leads are stored (enabled) and emailed (followUpEnabled), the code defaults, and the forms already created with the consent checkbox. Needs ads:manage.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms/consent.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.
